name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2025-11-29, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
